conclusion.selection_reason: Participant-safe cross-task diagnostic protocol; not a new frozen deployment candidate.
limitations: Phase 2E folds differ from official task-specific Phase 2C and Phase 2D folds.
Android clinical grouping is not the same target as DAIC PHQ8_Binary.
warnings: Cross-task findings are diagnostic and task-specific.
conclusion.next_step: Do not proceed without freezing a new protocol.

paper_interpretation.evaluation_protocol: Phase 2E participant-coherent nested five-fold cross-validation over 110 paired Androids Corpus participants
paper_interpretation.participant_level_split: new participant-coherent five-fold split shared by reading and interview tasks
paper_interpretation.paper_ready_result_sentence: Reading-to-interview transfer achieved ROC-AUC 0.8475 under participant-coherent nested cross-validation, with a matched-interview AUC gap of -0.0590.
allowed_claims: WavLM representations contain information shared across reading and interview tasks
cross-task transfer remained strong but lower than matched within-task performance
classifier boundaries were partly task-specific
prohibited_claims: statistical proof that pooled training is superior
comparison_caveats: All Phase 2E results are within Androids Corpus on 110 paired participants.
Pooled-task gains were suggestive rather than conclusive because bootstrap confidence intervals included zero.
